name: Cards Against Humanity
title: Online Multiplayer Game
description: This project is a personal redesign of the popular game Cards Against Humanity, an adult card game that combines creativity and dark humor by completing phrases with irreverent answers. The new version features an intuitive design that enhances the gaming experience while maintaining its original essence.

name: Taskitty
title: Android Agenda & Notes App
description: TaskKitty is an Android mobile application designed to manage notes and calendar dates with a charming cat theme. It offers customization options, allowing users to assign unique colors to each note and calendar event for easier visual organization. Its interface is friendly and attractive.

name: Med Copilot
title: Cross-Platform Consultation Management App
description: This application is a medical consultation management system that enables efficient administration of patients and their appointments. Users can view, add, edit, and delete patient records, including information such as first and last name, date of birth, contact details, and follow-ups.
long: This application is a medical consultation management system that enables efficient administration of patients and their appointments. Users can view, add, edit, and delete patient records, including information such as first and last name, date of birth, contact details, and follow-ups. Additionally, consultations are linked to specific patients, allowing users to add descriptions and manage records. Available on desktop and mobile devices, the app is designed to optimize patient care and improve the operational efficiency of clinics and medical practices.

name: Room Manager
title: Desktop Room Booking App
description: This application allows users to manage rooms and schedule associated events through an intuitive calendar. It offers the ability to categorize rooms by area, streamlining their organization and usage. Ideal for coordinating activities, its design focuses on simplifying planning and access to room availability.
